subject: Correctly cast the extension lengths (#2144)
reason: Correct one-token fix (uint16_t -> uint32_t) for truncating a cluster-bus ping-extension length. It is a genuine remote-input bug, but it only manifests when a received PING/PONG/MEET extension is >= 65536 bytes, and the fuzzer cannot deliver that: there is no cluster-bus packet injector, the only in-band trigger (an uncapped >64 KiB cluster-announce-human-nodename) is on the provider's forbidden-config list so no fault/cluster experiment can set it, normal-sized gossip never reaches the changed path (identical on both builds), and a received node's human-nodename is not reflected in any clien
